blocks.text: DUMANJUG, CEBU — A 13-year-old boy died after accidentally slipping into a river and drowning in Barangay Kabalaasnan on Saturday morning, November 21. Authorities identified the victim as a Grade 8 student and resident of Barangay Masa, Dumanjug. According to the initial investigation by the Dumanjug Municipal Police Station, the incident occurred at around 11:40 a.m. while the victim and his older sister were fetching water near the riverbank.
